evidence.note: Claim: ddflow next can surface enough from its ready set to decide LANE PLACEMENT by reading (not trial): each ready row's wave (from its wave:N tag), its declared needs, co_location_hints clustering items sharing a dep/globs, and (exclude_leased=True) which ready items a live lease already contends on. REFUTATION: a ready item overlapping another agent's lease is NOT offered (yet next_item(exclude_leased=True) shows it ready under deps_only) would refute. Cheapest test: tests/test_next_wave_group_deps_globs.py -- test_ready_items_sharing_a_dep_are_one_co_location_cluster + test_exclude_leased_drops_an_item_whose_globs_overlap_another_agents_lease. VERDICT THEORETICAL; the two probes CONFIRMED (5 passed). Flag names: flat, exclude_leased (next_item API params; CLI --flat/--exclude-leased wiring deferred: navigate.py leased by UX-output-caps-low-followups).

Applied scheduler research rules (B-next-phase-hides-blocking-deps B-next-phase-hides-blocking-deps blueprint, pure core colocation module, regression tests test_next_wave_group_deps_globs.py before merge). r-task-phase-needs-wave (wave:N tag is the group key), r-derived-cache-bounded (co-location derived on the ready set, pure), r-agent-parity (as_agent=nextgrp-kilo).

Commit ad61c4ee1 on ddflow/B-next-wave-group-deps-globs: ddflow/core/schedule/_colocate.py (wave_of, co_location_hints), ddflow/api/lifecycle/ready.py (flat/exclude_leased params, _offer_ready grouping, excluded_leased data), ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle_cli.py (next_text wave headers/needs inline/co-locate/excluded), ddflow/core/schedule/__init__.py (re-export). tests/test_next_wave_group_deps_globs.py (5 tests).

chunk_findings.detail: `_WAVE_TAG` is compiled from the raw pattern `wave:\\d+`, which matches a literal backslash and the letter `d`, not digits. Given tags `["wave:0"]` or `["wave:3"]`, `wave_of` never fullmatches and returns `None`, so every stamped item is treated as unstamped and sorts after real waves instead of by its `wave:N` number.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/core/schedule/_colocate.py:25

chunk_findings.detail: When more than one ready item is shown and `flat` is false, the footer always says “These are independent — run them in parallel worktrees” even if `co_location_hints` is non-empty. Given two ready items that share a dependency or overlapping globs, that sentence is false: those items are the co-locate cluster printed immediately below, and running them in parallel worktrees is the locking case the change is meant to advise against.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle_cli.py:323

chunk_findings.detail: The nothing-ready / nothing-blocking path prints `excluded_leased` with the same `item: reason — detail` lines as `p.blocked`, and no “Excluded (globs overlap another agent's live lease)” header. Given an empty ready set, no blocking deps, and one leased-overlap exclusion, that row is indistinguishable from a blocked task (and KeyErrors if the entry only has `item` and `detail`, which is all the non-empty path reads).
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle_cli.py:295

chunk_findings.detail: The old path printed `Ready (...):` only inside `if p.ready:`. The caller now invokes `_next_ready_lines` whenever that early return does not fire, including `not p.ready and bdeps`. `_next_ready_lines` always starts with `lines = [f"Ready ({p.summary()}):"]`. Given a phase with no ready items and one or more blocking dependencies, the CLI emits an empty Ready section (header, no rows) before the blocking-dependency list. That was previously omitted.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle_cli.py:_next_ready_lines

chunk_findings.detail: Wave headers are not stable for unstamped items. `last_k` starts as `None` and is also the bucket `wave_of` returns when there is no wave tag, and the header condition is `last_k is None or last_k != k`. After the first unstamped item, `last_k` is set back to `None`, so the next unstamped item always takes the `last_k is None` branch and prints another `[wave:unstamped]` header. Two ready items with no wave tag therefore render as two separate groups instead of one, which is the opposite of grouping ready items by wave.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle_cli.py:_next_ready_lines
